schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Grouped so a lint config and the plugins it loads never land apart.
Pinned at the root and re-pinned through a pnpm override, so every copy has to move together. Ordered after eslint so eslint-config-prettier lands here.
Ordered after eslint so eslint-plugin-storybook lands here.
Both workspaces install playwright and the vitest browser provider drives it; a version skew fails every story smoke test at once.
Three workspaces declare typescript and CLAUDE.md requires them aligned.
Payload core and its plugins are version-locked to each other. Six are pinned exactly and five carry carets, so an ungrouped bump splits the tree across two Payload versions.
The Throughline suite ships as a set. All 0.x, so config:recommended already treats a minor as breaking.

Automerge only what CI actually proves. This depends on the verify job running on renovate/** branches — see .github/workflows/ci.yml. If that ever stops being true, a green check means the fast tier only and this rule must come out.

These can move payload-types.ts, select-options.json or importMap.js, which check-generated.sh will fail on and no bot here can regenerate — postUpgradeTasks is self-hosted only. Ordered after the automerge rule so it overrides it.
Majors queue on the dependency dashboard rather than opening at once. Each open PR is a preview deploy that migrates and seeds the shared database and runs every cron against it.
